datasets.name: all_alerts
queryLines:
SELECT
  alert_id,
  alert_type,
  alert_timestamp,
  customer_name,
  CONCAT('**** ', RIGHT(card_number, 4)) AS masked_card,
  amount,
  currency,
  merchant_name,
  risk_level AS severity
FROM
  sentinel.gold.fraud_card_alert
UNION ALL
SELECT
  alert_id,
  alert_type,
  alert_timestamp,
  customer_name,
  'n/a' AS masked_card,
  transaction_amount AS amount,
  currency,
  merchant_name,
  status AS severity
FROM
  sentinel.gold.high_value_transactions_alert
ORDER BY
  alert_timestamp DESC
